metadata.lecture_topic: Почему нормализация по мини-батчам важна для обучения RNN?

turns.content: Почему нормализация по мини-батчам важна для обучения RNN?

turns.model_response:
По	minи-батчам нормализация normalize training batch size, что означает, чтоTrain_batch_size = n, где n — количествоbatch за раз. minibatches.

Если train_batch_size too small, then the learning rate will be too large and it may lead to overshooting the minimum loss. If train_batch_size too big, then the loss over many batches may add up and it may take too long to converge on a good solution.

minibatch_size = 32. This means that each training sample is split into 32 mini-batches before passing them through the network.
